claims.text: The three ontologies used are the Wine Ontology, the m-piro ontology, and the Disease Ontology.
The Wine Ontology is commonly used and contains 77 classes, 161 individuals, and 14 relations.
The m-piro ontology describes museum exhibits and was developed in the m-piro project.
The Disease Ontology describes diseases, including their symptoms and causes.
